title: Composition and Expertise of Steering Committee for Singapore College of Islamic Studies
what_it_is: Composition and Expertise of Steering Committee for Singapore College of Islamic Studies

sections.label: Non-Muslim Board members appointed
sections.summary: Non-Muslim members form less than half of the Board of Governors and Steering Committee and are appointed for their diverse expertise with the Muslim community.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The non-Muslim members make up less than half of the Board of Governors and Steering Committee, and are appointed for their diverse expertise and experience in working with the Muslim community.

sections.label: Board induction and community engagement
sections.summary: All Board members undergo a structured induction programme and regularly engage Muslim religious, community and madrasah leaders and students.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: All Board members undergo a structured induction programme, which includes briefings on the mission, vision and values, and objectives of the College.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: They also engage regularly with Muslim religious and community leaders as well as madrasah leaders and students to understand how the SCIS can best serve the community.

sections.label: Professional development and career support unit
sections.summary: A dedicated professional development and career support unit is planned for more than 50 students, with broader careers and further expansion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Fadli Fawzi (Aljunied)
sentences.text: And third, will this college have a dedicated professional development and career support unit for the students?

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We are planning perhaps for more than 50 students and we will expand this further.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: In terms of careers, as I mentioned, it will be much broader compared to what we can see today.

sections.label: Career development programmes yearly
sections.summary: Programmes will be conducted year after year to develop students' careers and deepen their experience.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We want them to deepen and develop their experience.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Therefore, we will conduct programmes that develop their careers year after year.

sections.label: Shaping something together with community
sections.summary: The sentiment is something unique that Singapore is better placed to do and wants to shape together with the Muslim community and wider society.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: They shared the same sentiment – something unique, something that Singapore is in a better place to do, and that is something we want to shape together.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: I want to assure Members that we want to shape it together with the Muslim community here as well, including the bigger Singapore society.

sections.label: Engaging professionals in advisory roles
sections.summary: Professionals will be engaged to play advisory roles in planned efforts, including curriculum development and partnerships.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: I will also look into how we want to engage the various professionals that can play a part.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We will be looking at how they can even play advisory roles in some of the efforts that we plan, even some aspects of curriculum development and partnerships.

sections.label: Muslim community nation building
sections.summary: The day is a milestone to bring the Muslim community forward and include it in Singapore's nation building.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: For today, is a milestone for us to bring the Muslim community forward and to be part of nation building here in Singapore.
